paper.title: Imaginary crystal bases for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$-modules in category $\mathcal O^q_{\text{red,im}}$
paper.abstract: Recently we defined imaginary crystal bases for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$- modules in category $\mathcal O^q_{\text{red,im}}$ and showed the existence of such bases for reduced quantized imaginary Verma modules for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$. In this paper we show the existence of imaginary crystal basis for any object in the category $\mathcal O^q_{\text{red,im}}$.
